mapper.insert: MERGE INTO fx_rate t USING ( SELECT #{countryId} AS country_id, #{currencyCode} AS currency_code, #{baseDate} AS base_date FROM dual ) s ON ( t.country_id = s.country_id AND t.currency_code = s.currency_code AND t.base_date = s.base_date ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET deal_bas_r = #{dealBasR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (fx_rate_id, country_id, currency_code, deal_bas_r, base_date) VALUES (seq_fx_rate.NEXTVAL, #{countryId}, #{currencyCode}, #{dealBasR}, #{baseDate})
INSERT INTO fx_rate (fx_rate_id, country_id, currency_code, deal_bas_r, base_date) VALUES (seq_fx_rate.NEXTVAL, #{countryId}, #{currencyCode}, #{dealBasR}, #{baseDate})
mapper.select: SELECT fx_rate_id AS fxRateId, country_id AS countryId, currency_code AS currencyCode, deal_bas_r AS dealBasR, base_date AS baseDate FROM fx_rate WHERE country_id = #{countryId} ORDER BY base_date DESC FETCH FIRST 7 ROWS ONLY
